THE 1ST LOW FUEL BURNLIGHT TURBOPROP

The turboprop is the perfect solution to power light aircraft, helicopters and drones. Compact, reliable and vibration-free, the turboprop combines all the advantages of a gas turbine with very low fuel consumption. Thanks to its poly-fuel capacity, long-range travel is not an issue anymore.

THE 1st REGENERATIVE TURBOPROP

  • Using a patented heat exchanger, the TP-R150 offers a fuel-burn on par with the best piston engines on the market.
  • A 104kW turboprop using the principal of recovering energy contained in the exhaust gases. Light and compact, reliable and vibration free, the TP-R150 offers all the advantages of a gas turbine and combines them with a very low fuel consumption.

RELIABILITY & COST MANAGEMENT

  • In direct lineage with its jumbo-jet cousins, Turbotech turbine engines have a notably higher reliability (MTBF) and lifetime (TBO) than its piston counterparts. Turbotech is setting a new standard in light aviation reliability and longevity.
  • This unique piece of engineering is also respectful of the environment, with an ultra-quiet signature and very low emissions.

EAGER TO TAKE PART IN THE AVIATION TRANSITION TO GREENER FLYING SOLUTIONS ?

THE ULTIMATE HYBRID-ELECTRIC SOLUTION

TURBOGENERATOR

The Turbogenerator is an onboard electrical genset and is a powerful enabler for electrical propulsion architectures. Turbotech develops a high power class turbogenerator of 85kW. TG-R90 is the first onboard electrical gensets dedicated to the hybrid-electric aircraft industry.

THE ALL-IN-ONE ON BOARD ELECTRICAL GENSET

  • Recharging batteries during  flight.
  • Seamless integration in hybrid  aircraft architectures.
  • This plug-and-play  approach, combined with low operational  costs, optimised fuel consumption and  reduced CO2 emissions, makes it the most  reliable solution in the hybrid-electric aircraft  sector today.

ENABLING LONG-RANGE ELECTRIC FLIGHT

  • The highest power to weight ratio, compared to any other electricity storage technology: equivalent to the energy contained in 1 ton of battery.
  • Turbogenerator TG-R90 generates electric power onboard and paves the way to hybrid-electric architectures. Used in conjunction with batteries, it can offer up to 10 times more range than a full-electric plane.
